latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of defi-stop-loss skill providing decentralized, gasless stop-loss orders across major EVM chains.

- Enables setting gasless, non-custodial, oracle-protected stop-loss orders on 8 EVM chains via supported DEXs.
- Supports full order lifecycle: param normalization, order shaping, signing, submission, querying, and cancellation through clear local instructions.
- Provides authoritative, chain-specific adapter addresses and relay endpoints for order handling.
- All workflows and guardrails clearly documented for safe and correct usage.
- Extensively references local markdown/JSON assets; no external code execution required.
